Hi Samir — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposal so we keep momentum:

2) Combined technical deep-dive + pilot runbook — 60 min: infra options (private vs. dedicated), security controls, quantization/perf profiles, pilot milestones. Marcus will lead the technical portion.
